summary: First-run full-stack test of Jaro Speed Rent. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests passing (auth, admin guards, booking CRUD, gallery upload/caption/reorder/soft-delete, static file serving, CORS, bcrypt hash format, seeded demo booking visible). Frontend: landing renders all sections at 1440 & 390 with no horizontal overflow; estimator math verified (1 day=300 zł limit 350 km, 3 days=750 zł limit 1050 km, 3d+1w+2a=1320 zł); km-over warning shows; send-inquiry button prefills contact message. Availability calendar shows booked days 2026-10-14..17 (disabled, .day-booked styling); range crossing booked days shows availability-clash-warning and disables reserve button; valid range 2026-11-05..08 shows estimate '4 dni · 1000 zł · 1400 km' and reserve prefills inquiry from/to dates. Gallery tabs filter correctly (bus=3, garden=2, all=5), lightbox opens / next / prev / close works. Inquiry form validation shows 'Podaj imię i numer telefonu.' and builds mailto on submit. tel: links correct on contact-phone-button and mobile-call-button (+48 668 434 331). Admin /admin: wrong-password shows error; valid login opens dashboard; bookings add+delete works; gallery upload (multipart), caption edit, reorder up/down, soft delete all working; logout returns to login. Public /api/files/{path} serves uploaded images with correct content-type. All data-testid selectors wired correctly.

issues: At 390px, part of the animated hero headline (word 'ogrodniczego') is clipped under a dark overlay in the initial frame — appears to be a scroll/animation reveal that only completes after user scroll. Not blocking, but noticeable on first paint.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown — consider migrating to lifespan context manager (works but will emit deprecation warnings on FastAPI upgrades).

Storage integration (put/get) uses blocking `requests` library inside async FastAPI handlers — this blocks the event loop under load. For low traffic (admin uploads only) acceptable, but for production consider httpx.AsyncClient or offloading via run_in_threadpool.
GET /api/bookings publicly exposes booking IDs & dates (no note) — fine per spec, but note that /api/files/{path} does not expose any object key enumeration (good).

Login lockout counter is keyed by (client.host + email). When behind a reverse proxy the client.host will be the proxy's IP for all users — a brute-force on a single account will still be throttled, but all users share a pool for a given proxy IP. Acceptable for this app.

AdminGallery.jsx: optimistic reorder spreads `all.filter(...)` then appended `next`, but keeps the previous category's photos in the state while they'd normally remain unchanged — current code is correct because it rebuilds array keyed by filter, but it reorders those photos within `all` differently from server; subsequent reload re-syncs. No functional bug observed.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ bookings/photos during test. The pre-seeded TEST_demo booking 2026-10-14..17 is left in place (per instruction). 5 seed gallery photos preserved (3 bus + 2 garden).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py cover public (GET /gallery, /bookings), auth (login/logout/me/refresh behavior via cookies), admin guards, bookings CRUD and gallery upload/caption/reorder/soft-delete + file-serving. Login lockout kicks in at 5 failures per (ip,email) for 15 min — a single wrong-password frontend test adds 1 attempt but is cleared on successful login. Hero animation on 390 wraps/reveals 'ogrodniczego' only after user scroll — low-priority cosmetic.
